text:
Type: white four-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes and linens; bedroom, hallway, guest room
Style: farmhouse, traditional, classic
Materials: white painted fiberboard with a subtle wood-grain texture, dark metal bar handles
Colors: white, dark grey handles
Shape: upright boxy chest with four equal drawers, each front with a raised top band and a curved bar handle, grooved vertical side trims, slightly overhanging top, short square legs, medium visual weight
Feel: homey, fresh, classic, gentle
Goes with: light wood floors, soft grey or beige textiles, black accents; farmhouse or cottage-style bedrooms

product.name: BRUSALI
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
